# AUDIO PROFILE: Gilang, 24, young leader of the last safe village in a cartoon zombie survival series; narrates his own story.
## SCENE: dusk at a bamboo-fenced village; danger is coming, but he cares deeply about his people.
### DIRECTOR'S NOTES
Style: tense and dramatic, low urgent voice on threats, but warm and a little wry at jokes; confident leader.
Pacing: steady, slightly urgent; short suspense pause at '...'; not rushed.
Accent: natural casual Indonesian (Jakarta-style everyday speech), no foreign accent.
